card-prompt.purpose: Primary retrieval question in study column; SwiftUI .title

motion.name: reveal-crossfade
motion.purpose: Answer reveal in study view; disabled when Reduce Motion is on — use instant cut.

motion.name: grade-submit
motion.purpose: No animation between cards; swap content immediately to preserve study flow.

platformNotes.macOS14: Semantic system colors; standard NavigationSplitView materials.
platformNotes.macOS26: Optional Liquid Glass on sidebar and toolbar only; study content stays opaque.
platformNotes.iOSFuture: Stack navigation; bottom-fixed grade bar; 44pt touch targets.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Study, Show Answer, Done. SwiftUI .borderedProminent with app tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4A6FA5; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d5f8f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4A6FA5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grade Button
components.css: .ds-btn-grade { background: transparent; color: #1d1d1f; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-grade:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-btn-grade:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4A6FA5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Study Reading Column
components.description: Centered card stage, max 600pt. Prompt, divider, answer — no shadow box.
components.html:
What is the capital of France?

Paris
components.css: .ds-study-column { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; padding: 24px 32px; } .ds-prompt { font: 400 28px/1.25 -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui; margin: 0 0 24px; } .ds-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); margin: 24px 0; } .ds-answer { font: 400 22px/1.3 -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); margin: 0; }

components.description: Inline study error with icon; never color alone.

narrative.overview: NeoAnki2 should feel like a well-lit desk: one open page (the card), a tidy stack of notes to the side (the item list), and almost nothing else competing for attention. Platform-native restraint and content-forward layout. The card is the only hero per screen.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Custom accent color appears only on primary forward actions (Study, Show Answer, Done on completion).

rules.name: The No Gamification Palette Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce streak orange, achievement gold, or chart rainbow colors.

rules.name: The Card Type Scale Rule
rules.body: Only card prompt uses .title; only card answer uses .title2. UI chrome never borrows card sizes.

rules.name: The Dynamic Type Rule
rules.body: Use semantic SwiftUI text styles — never hard-coded point sizes in production views.

rules.name: The Split-First Rule
rules.body: Study never returns to a sheet modal on Mac. Detail pane owns the session.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Card text lives in a centered column capped at 600pt.

rules.name: The Flat Study Stage Rule
rules.body: The study card is not a boxed card with shadow. Divider and typography only.

rules.name: The Platform Shape Rule
rules.body: Use system control geometry; custom radii only for future media containers.

dos: Do keep one primary action visible per study phase
Do expose keyboard paths and document in Grade Help
Do test Light, Dark, and Increased Contrast
Do adopt Liquid Glass on sidebar/toolbar for macOS 26 with opaque study content
donts: Don't gamify with streaks, XP, or progress rings
Don't put shadows, gradients, or glass on card content
Don't use display serifs or cute illustration styles
Don't copy Anki density or Quizlet game UI
Don't show scheduling stats during active review
